- UND_MyconidCircle_CheckpointGuard_002.json: You’ve stumbled into a myconid guard circle in the Underdark; the sentries telepathically notify their Sovereign, which answers as a single, choir‑like consciousness that interrogates you through visions and fungal imagery. - UND_MyconidSovereign.json: You are speaking with a brooding myconid sovereign who communicates telepathically through dissonant song and nightmarish visions rather than normal speech; the circle functions like a hive mind and its impressions wash over you like whispers and moans. Off‑screen, duergar recently attacked myconid kin, leaving corpses and survivors, and the sovereign (a displaced myconid — often called Glut in related beats) has come to this circle seeking revenge and offers to ally with you to “cleanse” the grotto. Early in the scene he can be recruited, but he steadily escalates from demanding a single duergar’s death to urging wholesale slaughter and even assassination of a rival sovereign (Spaw) so only he remains. The visions often show duergar butchery and sometimes a fate for you wrapped in tendrils; the player’s lines (kneeling, conjuring calm memories, questioning battle) reflect attempts to placate or resist a telepathic, increasingly menacing pressure.
- UND_MyconidCircle_BroodingSovereign.json: The brooding sovereign, Sovereign Glut, is a displaced myconid who fled into this circle after duergar attacked his home and now offers to join you so you can cleanse the grotto of those duergar — ostensibly for revenge. Early in the scene he can be recruited into your group, but as the quest progresses he pushes you from killing a lone duergar to clearing all the duergar, and finally to assassinating the rival Sovereign (Spaw) so only Glut remains. Some branches imply the player has already slain kin or other threats, which feeds Glut’s talk of “excising” a tumour and his hunger for dominance. He speaks apart from the other myconids in a creepy, sing-song voice with a low menace (think FART from Rick and Morty), and his tone steadily grows angrier and more threatening as he pressures the player to carry out bloodier acts.

retrieved_synopses: You come upon the myconid guards. They warn the sovereign of your presence telepathically, and it begins to speak to you. This should be creepy, hallucinatory.

You’ve stumbled into a myconid guard circle in the Underdark; the sentries telepathically notify their Sovereign, which answers as a single, choir‑like consciousness that interrogates you through visions and fungal imagery. Off‑screen the player is carrying a mind‑flayer tadpole (and may have recently been involved with the Emerald Grove/Halsin and other NPCs), so other characters’ prior reactions and alarms help explain why strange minds are probing you now. The Sovereign’s speech is hallucinatory and intrusive — a layered chorus, rising to a single commanding voice that threatens with visions of your body entwined by fungus while it demands your purpose. Other nearby NPCs or recent events (grove politics, dealings with hags or drow) can affect tone, but this scene is primarily a telepathic, creepy interrogation by the myconid collective.

You are speaking with a brooding myconid sovereign who communicates telepathically through dissonant song and nightmarish visions rather than normal speech; the circle functions like a hive mind and its impressions wash over you like whispers and moans. Off‑screen, duergar recently attacked myconid kin, leaving corpses and survivors, and the sovereign (a displaced myconid — often called Glut in related beats) has come to this circle seeking revenge and offers to ally with you to “cleanse” the grotto. Early in the scene he can be recruited, but he steadily escalates from demanding a single duergar’s death to urging wholesale slaughter and even assassination of a rival sovereign (Spaw) so only he remains. The visions often show duergar butchery and sometimes a fate for you wrapped in tendrils; the player’s lines (kneeling, conjuring calm memories, questioning battle) reflect attempts to placate or resist a telepathic, increasingly menacing pressure.

The brooding sovereign, Sovereign Glut, is a displaced myconid who fled into this circle after duergar attacked his home and now offers to join you so you can cleanse the grotto of those duergar — ostensibly for revenge. Early in the scene he can be recruited into your group, but as the quest progresses he pushes you from killing a lone duergar to clearing all the duergar, and finally to assassinating the rival Sovereign (Spaw) so only Glut remains. Some branches imply the player has already slain kin or other threats, which feeds Glut’s talk of “excising” a tumour and his hunger for dominance. He speaks apart from the other myconids in a creepy, sing-song voice with a low menace (think FART from Rick and Morty), and his tone steadily grows angrier and more threatening as he pressures the player to carry out bloodier acts.
